newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Bid for Orion declared unconditional.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Bid for Orion declared unconditional.

text.p: Gold Miner Sons of Gwalia Ltd said on Tuesday it had declared its A$1.80 per share takeover bid for Orion Resources NL unconditional and repeated that the offer would not be increased.
Sons of Gwalia also said the payment period had been reduced to five business days after acceptance.
"As we have previously stated, the offer is final," Sons of Gwalis Managing Director Peter Lalor said in a statement.
"There cannot be any increase," he said.
Last week, Orion repeated that it saw the bid as neither fair nor reasonable and released an independent report increasing forecast annual production from its Yilgarn Star mine by 30 percent.
Sons of Gwalia said the independent report's valuation of Orion's shares at between A$1.92 and A$2.14 could not be sustantiated.

"Their valuation model assumes gold production of more than twice existing reserves, a base gold price of A$515 per ounce compared with today's actual price of A$483 and then adds a further 60 to 70 percent premium to the value calculated," Lalor said.
Coeur d'Alene Mines Corp of the United States has a 19 percent stake in Orion.
